metadata.name: Neuro-Augmented Codon Table
metadata.description: Codon table for neuromorphic blood science and genetic repair operations
metadata.author: Strategickhaos DAO LLC

codon_table.operation: Detect seizure patterns in EEG/iEEG using neuromorphic spike detection
codon_table.description: Real-time seizure detection via spiking neural networks. Processes EEG bursts, HFO ripples (80-500Hz), and chirp patterns.
references: Neuromorphic Deep SNN for Seizure Detection (IOP Science, 2022)

codon_table.operation: Detect high-frequency oscillations (80-500Hz) in iEEG as epilepsy biomarkers
codon_table.description: Event-based HFO detection for epileptic focus localization. Integrates with closed-loop stimulation.
references: Electronic Neuromorphic System for HFO Detection in iEEG (Nature Communications, 2021)

codon_table.operation: Detect chirp patterns (progressive frequency changes) as seizure onset precursors
codon_table.description: Early warning system for seizure onset via theta phase progression detection.
references: Event-Based Seizure Detection in Human iEEG (medRxiv, 2025)

codon_table.operation: Classify blood cells (RBC, WBC, platelets) using neuromorphic cytometry
codon_table.description: Real-time blood cell classification via event-based imaging. Detects morphological anomalies.

codon_table.operation: Detect sickle cell anemia via RBC morphology analysis and HbS mutation detection
codon_table.description: Detects malformed (crescent-shaped) red blood cells and correlates with HBB gene mutation (Glu6Val).
codon_table.integration: Combines cytometry (cell_variance) with genetic analysis (variant detection)

codon_table.operation: Detect hemophilia via clotting factor deficiency and F8/F9 gene variants
codon_table.description: Monitors coagulation phase drift (TRIG6 D) and detects pathogenic variants in clotting factor genes.

codon_table.operation: Simulate DNA recon/CRISPR for blood disorders (e.g., sickle cell hemoglobin repair)
codon_table.description: Generates CRISPR sgRNA guides for genetic repair of blood disorders. Simulates base editing for HBB E6V correction.

crispr_params.notes: Parameters are configurable per Cas protein type

workflow: 1. Identify pathogenic variant via ClinVar lookup
2. Generate sgRNA candidates targeting mutation site
4. Evolve guides using TRIG6 fitness landscape

codon_table.operation: Detect DNA motifs in genetic sequences using neuromorphic pattern matching
codon_table.description: Spike-encodes DNA sequences and detects conserved motifs via parallel matching on TrueNorth cores.

codon_table.operation: Cluster glyphs (EEG symbols, blood cell types) using TrueNorth parallel processing
codon_table.description: Massive parallelism for symbol assignment. Maps glyphs to clusters via eq (pattern closeness).

codon_table.operation: Evaluate TRIG6 fitness (R, D, N, eq) for input glyphs
codon_table.description: Core TRIG6 SAGCO-OS fitness evaluation with blood-neuro correlations.

codon_table.operation: Evolve codons via mutation and selection based on TRIG6 fitness
codon_table.description: Evolutionary loop for codon optimization. Mutates parameters and selects based on fitness.

codon_table.operation: Trigger seizure alert when danger predicate |tan(theta)| > limit is met
codon_table.description: Automated alert for seizure onset. Can trigger neurostimulation devices for suppression.

codon_table.operation: Trigger alert when cell_variance > 0.9 indicating sickle cell crisis
codon_table.description: Alerts for sickle cell vaso-occlusive crisis based on RBC morphology entropy.

codon_table.operation: Trigger alert when clotting_drift > 0.8 indicating bleeding risk
codon_table.description: Alerts for hemophilia-related bleeding risk via coagulation phase monitoring.

codon_table.operation: Correlate EEG drift with blood gene expression for neurogenetic disorders
codon_table.description: Detects neuro symptoms from blood disorders (e.g., sickle cell stroke, ion channel mutations).
examples: SCN gene mutations affecting both seizures and blood pH
Sickle cell anemia causing neurological symptoms

codon_table.operation: Call genetic variants from VCF files and classify via ClinVar
codon_table.description: Variant calling pipeline with pathogenicity classification. Feeds into TRIG6 eq calculation.

codon_table.operation: Simulate organic neuromorphic polymer synthesis for artificial hemoglobin
codon_table.description: Bioelectronics simulation for hemoglobin analog synthesis. Maps polymer entropy to TRIG6 N.

codon_table.operation: Design DNA strand displacement circuits for wetware neuromorphic computing
codon_table.description: DNA-based molecular computing for in-vivo genetic repair. Maps circuit error to TRIG6 eq.

codon_table.operation: Deploy evolved SNN to Intel Loihi hardware for real-time inference
codon_table.description: Hardware deployment for production inference. Targets <1mW power consumption.

codon_table.operation: Deploy glyph clustering to IBM TrueNorth emulator/hardware
codon_table.description: Parallel deployment for symbol assignment and pattern matching tasks.

codon_properties.extensibility: New codons can be added without breaking existing operations
codon_properties.genetic_integration: CRISPR simulation codons include repair strategies and target genes
codon_properties.trig6_compatible: All operations map to TRIG6 parameters (R, D, N, eq)

usage_examples.workflow: Ingest EEG -> Detect patterns -> Evaluate fitness -> Trigger alert if needed
Classify cells -> Detect morphology anomalies -> Call HBB variant -> Generate CRISPR guide -> Alert if crisis
Detect seizures in EEG -> Correlate with blood gene expression -> Evaluate combined fitness
Call pathogenic variant -> Generate repair guides -> Evaluate via TRIG6 eq -> Evolve guides
